# Getting Started

## Set Up

Attach the required R packages to your local environment via the `library()` call
```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
library(Coereba)
library(flowGate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

Designate file paths to the folder with your .fcs files, and a desired storage location for any intermediate outputs. 

```{r}
Folder <- "PMA_Antibody"
StorageLocation <- file.path("data", Folder)

OutputLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder)
if (!dir.exists(OutputLocation)){dir.create(OutputLocation)}
```

Proceed to load the .fcs files into a GatingSet object. 

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation,
 pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)

UnmixedCytoSet <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files,
 truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)

UnmixedGatingSet <- GatingSet(UnmixedCytoSet)
```

## Metadata

Check the current metadata status.

```{r}
pData(UnmixedGatingSet)
```

```{r}
Bid <- function(filename) {
  bid <- str_extract(filename, "INF\\d{3}")
  bid <- data.frame(bid, check.names=FALSE)
}

Condition <- function(filename) {
  Condition <-str_extract(filename, "(?<=INF\\d{3}-)[A-Za-z]+(?=_Antibody)")
  Condition  <- data.frame(Condition, check.names=FALSE)
}

Experiment <- function(filename) {
  Experiment <- str_extract(filename, "ILT_\\d{2}")
  Experiment <- data.frame(Experiment, check.names=FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
pd <- pData(UnmixedGatingSet)

Names <- pd |> pull(name)

TheNames <- pd
TheBID <- map(.x=Names, .f=Bid) |> bind_rows()
TheCondition <- map(.x=Names, .f=Condition) |> bind_rows()
TheExperiment <- map(.x=Names, .f=Experiment) |> bind_rows()

TheIntermediate <- bind_cols(TheNames, TheBID, TheCondition, TheExperiment)
```

```{r}
TheMetadata <- file.path("data", "Metadata.csv")
TheMetadataDF <- read.csv(TheMetadata, check.names=FALSE)
AddThisMetada <- TheMetadataDF |> select(bid, ptype, infant_sex)
UpdatedMetadata <- left_join(TheIntermediate, AddThisMetada, by="bid")
rownames(UpdatedMetadata) <- rownames(pd)

# UpdatedMetadata |> View()

pData(UnmixedGatingSet) <- UpdatedMetadata
```

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
pData(UnmixedGatingSet) |> View()
```

## Transformation

Proceed to transform and visualize your data to ensure that everything looks okay before proceeding.

```{r}
#| label: "Biexponential Transformation"
#| message: false
Markers <- colnames(UnmixedCytoSet)
KeptMarkers <- Markers[-grep("Time|FS|SC|SS|Original|-W$|-H$|AF", Markers)]

Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=4194304,
     pos=5.62, neg=1, widthBasis=-1000)
TransformList <- transformerList(KeptMarkers, Biexponential)
UnmixedGatingSet <- transform(UnmixedGatingSet, TransformList)
```

```{r}
markernames(UnmixedGatingSet[1])
```

```{r}
ggcyto(UnmixedGatingSet[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="BUV496-A", y="BUV805-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

ggcyto(UnmixedGatingSet[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="CD7", y="CD3")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

ggcyto(UnmixedGatingSet[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="CD45RA", y="CD3")) + geom_hex(bins=100)
```

## Gating

## Creating Clean Up Gates

With our template setup, and our files loaded into a GatingSet, we can add draw cleanup gates to ensure we are only providing our cell type of interest when we draw the positive gates. 

To do this, we will leverage the `flowGate` packages ShinyApp. 

```{r}
CellGatingTable <- tibble::tribble(
  ~filterId,    ~dims,                          ~subset,      
  "scatter",   list("FSC-A", "SSC-A"),          "root", 
  "singlets",   list("FSC-A", "FSC-H"),         "scatter",
  "live",   list("FSC-A", "Zombie NIR-A"),      "singlets",
  "CD7+",   list("Pacific Blue-A", "BV711-A"),  "live",
  "Tcells",list("BV510-A", "Spark Blue 550-A"),  "CD7+",
  "NotVd2cells",list("BUV661-A", "Spark Blue 550-A"),  "Tcells",
  "NotNKTcells",list("FITC-A", "Spark Blue 550-A"),  "NotVd2cells",
  "NotMAITcells",list("BV480-A", "Alexa Fluor 647-A"),  "NotNKTcells",
  "CD4Tcells",list("BUV496-A", "BUV805-A"),  "NotMAITcells",
  "CD8Tcells",list("BUV496-A", "BUV805-A"),  "NotMAITcells",
  "DNTcells",list("BUV496-A", "BUV805-A"),  "NotMAITcells",
  "NKLikecells",list("BV510-A", "Spark Blue 550-A"),  "CD7+",
)
```

Create an initial gate based on one specimen (if using provided examples, we already downsampled so include everything!) 

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
flowGate::gs_apply_gating_strategy(UnmixedGatingSet, gating_strategy = CellGatingTable)
```

And check the gates across individual specimens. Don't forget to leave dead cells for the viability unmixing control!

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE

CheckTheseGates <- CellGatingTable |> pull(filterId)

#walk(.x=CheckTheseGates, .f=gs_apply_gate_check, gs=UnmixedGatingSet)

walk(.x=CheckTheseGates[12], .f=gs_apply_gate_check, gs=UnmixedGatingSet)

#plot(UnmixedGatingSet)
# ?gs_apply_gate_check
```

## Save GatingSet 

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
StoreHere <- file.path(OutputLocation, "SDY3080_PMA.gs")
save_gs(UnmixedGatingSet, StoreHere)
```

TheseScripts <- list.files("R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
walk(.x=TheseScripts, .f=source)
```

```

```{r}
NewLocation <- file.path(OutputLocation, "CD4")
if (!dir.exists(NewLocation)){dir.create(NewLocation)}

AllCD4s <- purrr::map(.x=UnmixedGatingSet, subset="CD4Tcells",
 .f=Downsampling, DownsampleCount=10000000, addon="CD4Tcells",
  returnType="fcs", StorageLocation=NewLocation)
```
